outcome: Concentrations of POPs in human breast milk
cohort: The study included 513 first-time lactating mothers from two Norwegian cohorts (the HUMIS study and the "Iodine in Early Life"-Study) whose breast milk samples were collected between 2002 and 2021.
finding: The study observed a steady decrease in most POPs concentrations in breast milk from first-time mothers in Norway between 2002 and 2021, though b-HCH, ΣDDTs, and ΣBDEs showed increasing trends in mothers born between 1990-1994 compared to 1995-2002.
